regions.today: Sunny spells and scattered showers today, turning heavy at times. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees with light to moderate west to southwest winds, occasionally becoming fresh and gusty.
regions.tonight: Clear spells and scattered showers tonight, turning heavy at times. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees with light to moderate west to northwest winds, occasionally increasing fresh and gusty.
regions.tomorrow: Sunny spells and scattered showers will continue tomorrow. Temperatures will reach 17 to 20 degrees and there’ll be a moderate to fresh northerly breeze.
